text.tspan: World population supported by synthetic nitrogen fertilizers
Best estimates project that just over half of the global population could be sustained without reactive nitrogen
fertilizer derived from the Haber-Bosch process.

tspan.tspan: Erisman et al. (2008); Population based on various sources (2024)
Data up to 2008 comes from Erisman et al. (2008), who estimated that synthetic nitrogen fertilizers fed around half of the world's

text.tspan: population, which is supported by more recent studies. Later figures change only due to population growth.
